mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.5% relative to its 12-month moving average signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns following FEDFUNDS declines below 2.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers market anticipation of aggressive rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract under higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 2.5% indicates inflationary pressure with delayed policy response, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to rising real rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that accelerate wage growth and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST above 1150 thousand units indicates robust housing market demand, which correlates with elevated consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns following HOUST > 1150 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 105.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in RSAFS below 500,000 million dollars and HOUST below 1100 thousand units indicates weakening housing market demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO above 110.0 in a high-growth manufacturing regime signals sustained industrial output expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 110.0.
